The '''Xeran Mining Corporation''' was a company that operated in the [[Alagon system/Legends|Alagon system]], during the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
The Corporation employed a number of workers in the Alagon system, but made them all redundant and replaced them with [[HND-9 mining droid]]s. In response, the workers formed the [[Worker's Militia]] and staged an uprising against Xeran Mining. The workers initially sabotaged a number of the HND-9 droids, causing the Corporation to force the former miners out their corporate housing. The workers then reprogrammed some of the droids to attack [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that were leaving the system, so Xeran hired some [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] to hunt down the leaders of the Militia. Eventually, the New Republic intervened and ended the conflict.
